findings.note: ESPN lists Freddy Peralta for TB (1.93 ERA in 4.2 postseason IP) against Cleveland LHP Parker Messick (5.40 ERA, 6 BB in 6.2 IP) for ALCS Game 2. Cleveland leads the series 1-0, ESPN's predictor gives TB 59.5%, the listed TB moneyline is -137, and Shane McClanahan is marked OUT.

Cleveland came back from 2-0 down to win Game 1 7-3, scoring all seven runs in the last four innings, and has now won four straight. The Rays managed only three runs from seven hits and two walks. CBS also says Cleveland's pitching staff was compromised after its five-game division series.

Cleveland had 14 hits and hit two homers off Rays ace Drew Rasmussen. José Ramírez went 3-for-5 and Vogt says he keeps feeling better after his hamate surgery. Midseason pickups Lowe and Adell also drove in runs, so Cleveland's offense looks better than its season stats.
